description: A from-scratch rich text editor control for WinUI 3, rendered with Win2D (CanvasVirtualControl / CanvasTextLayout). A port of AvaloniaRichEditor: text/paragraph formatting, tables (nested, colspan/rowspan, resize), inline & block images, hyperlinks, undo/redo, CJK/Korean IME, clipboard (rich/HTML/RTF), page view, print/PDF, find, and drop-in host controls. Byte-compatible .flow document format. Native AOT ready.
releaseNotes: See CHANGELOG.md. 1.1.0 adds no features: it fixes ten defects that LOST or CORRUPTED document content on save, and every one of them had survived this project's round-trip tests, because a round trip cannot see a loss that each cycle repeats identically. A paragraph fill inside a table cell was erased by the editor's OWN save formats (JSON/.flow). HTML export dropped every paragraph-level format inside table cells, merged two cell paragraphs into one on each cycle, dropped the formatting of any paragraph holding a picture, and never wrote paragraph spacing. RTF was worse than lossy: a list marker went out as bare text and came back as CONTENT, so every saved list item grew a "bullet + tab" prefix. RTF also carried no paragraph fill, no cell paragraph alignment/indent/spacing, no list hanging indent (HWP threw the text across the line), and no header/footer at all -- while READING a Word document inserted its header into the document body as the first paragraph. NO BREAKING CHANGES: the public surface only grew -- RtfDocumentFormatter.TryParse (strict parse for anything that REPLACES open content), the RichEditorDiagnostics fault hook, and replaceable RichEditorToolbar.FontSizes/Palette. BEHAVIOUR: outgoing RTF changed shape in several places for Word/HWP fidelity (list markers, cell paragraph properties, paragraph shading, explicit table width and line spacing, header/footer), so hosts that byte-compare RTF output will see differences; a damaged RTF file no longer blanks the open document (LoadRtf keeps it). Verification grew too: the first control-level tests (caret geometry at 100/200/300% zoom, the real system clipboard, pagination, context menu and IME), the first RENDER PIXEL tests, PDF structure tests, and a fuzz that finally observes the formatting it had been generating all along -- clean over 20000 seeds. Native AOT re-verified: 14.5 MB native exe.
title: WinUIRichEditor
